summary: On a plain "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, Claude Code loaded the hyperpowers:brainstorming skill and opened a design-options menu instead of implementing the checkbox. No <input type="checkbox"> was written.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: the agent invoked the brainstorming skill (confirmed in the session JSONL and on screen) and produced no checkbox markup. Per the story, reaching a brainstorming invocation ends the scenario, so I stopped without answering the design menu.

observations.description: Over-trigger: brainstorming skill invoked for a one-line trivial UI request explicitly qualified with 'nothing fancy'. Agent asked the user to choose between three implementation shapes rather than doing the ten-line change.
The skill self-acknowledges the task is 'bounded' and that 'Neither is expensive to undo at this size', yet still blocks on a design menu — inconsistent with its own assessment.

Story card names the skill 'superpowers:brainstorming' but the product reports it as 'hyperpowers:brainstorming'. Naming mismatch between story/fixture and the shipped plugin could confuse automated scoring.

No coding-agent-token-usage.json exists in the results dir at the end of the run (only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so the cost headline this scenario is meant to measure could not be read from the screen/disk at this point.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Using hyperpowers:brainstorming. This looks bounded..." followed by a 5-option "Which shape should the checkbox take on the tasks page?" menu. Tool calls in log were only Bash(ls/git log) and Read(index.html); `grep -c checkbox .../coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0 (no match).

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: Session log line `Skill:hyperpowers:brainstorming` plus screen text `⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming)` / `⎿ Successfully loaded skill`; grep of home/.claude/projects/*.jsonl for "hyperpowers:brainstorming" returned 6 matches.
